claude_proposed_widenings.name: on_hit_trigger in ClassFeatureComponentMechanics
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Divine Strike upgrade deals 2d8 extra damage on a weapon hit. OnHitTriggerMechanics exists in MagicItemComponentMechanics but is absent from ClassFeatureComponentMechanics. ClassFeatureMechanics only admits PassiveMechanics and ActivatedAbilityMechanics, neither of which can express an on-weapon-hit rider.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Divine Strike. The extra damage of your Divine Strike increases to 2d8.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: on_caster_cantrip_deals_damage in OngoingTrigger
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Potent Spellcasting upgrade fires when the caster casts a cleric cantrip and deals damage to a creature. No existing OngoingTrigger variant captures 'caster cast a cantrip and dealt damage'. The closest, on_caster_attack_hit, is scoped to attack rolls and does not cover cantrip damage that resolves without a hit roll.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Potent Spellcasting. When you cast a Cleric cantrip and deal damage to a creature with it, you can give vitality to yourself or another creature within 60 feet of yourself.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: scaled ability_modifier coefficient in DiceExpr
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The temp HP amount is 'twice your Wisdom modifier'. DiceExpr supports a single abilityModifier field (implicitly ×1); there is no coefficient or multiplier for the ability modifier term, so 2 × WIS mod is not expressible.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: granting a number of Temporary Hit Points equal to twice your Wisdom modifier

claude_proposed_widenings.name: prior_choice_conditional encoding for class feature upgrades
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The feature upgrades whichever option the character chose at an earlier level. No surface mechanism exists to express 'this grant applies only if the character previously selected path X from feature Y'. The feature cannot be encoded as a single honest unit without this conditionality.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The option you chose for Blessed Strikes grows more powerful.
